ideas.pitch: A mobile-first computer vision app for smallholder farmers to diagnose crop nutrient deficiencies and pest stress using smartphone leaf photos, paired with localized yield forecasting.
ideas.title: AgriVision Yield & Soil Health Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the Agriculture domain with high social impact and clear economic metrics for farmers, satisfying key evaluation criteria for social impact and feasibility.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight invoice and ledger app for micro-merchants that automatically generates verifiable creditworthiness reports based on digital transaction histories.
ideas.title: CommerceTrust MSME Ledger & Credit Scorer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the Commerce domain by solving real financial inclusion problems for small merchants, scoring high on scalability and feasibility.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first multilingual voice assistant that helps rural health workers triage symptoms, log patient histories, and receive preliminary AI-driven diagnostic suggestions in regional languages.
ideas.title: ArogyaVoice Rural Health Triaging
ideas.why_it_could_win: Builds on proven health-tech patterns by incorporating multilingual support and addressing critical healthcare delivery gaps in rural populations.

ideas.pitch: An open-source web application for underfunded schools that assesses student mastery in core math and science concepts and dynamically generates customized remedial exercises.
ideas.title: SkillBridge Adaptive Learning Companion
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on the Education domain with a strong social impact angle, making it highly appealing to judges evaluating real-world utility and educational equity.

ideas.pitch: A logistics and pricing transparency platform connecting local agricultural producers directly with urban retail buyers to eliminate middlemen markups and reduce food waste.
ideas.title: KrishiMarket Direct Farmer-Buyer Link
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines Agriculture and Commerce domains with measurable economic benefit for producers, satisfying the high-priority judging criteria for concrete social and economic impact.
